title: Design: Customer card shows a deactivated term as Inactive
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure customer A is on Net 50, and Net 50 is deactivated.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design pictures ct-p6-01-customer-page-today.png, ct-p6-02-customer-on-a-deactivated-term.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Customers page.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The card at the left shows "Credit term" with "Net 50 (Inactive)" under it, whole and not cut off, in the same place and style as today's card (compare ct-p6-02-customer-on-a-deactivated-term.png and today's ct-p6-01-customer-page-today.png).

Step 2:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Do not compare the credit limit value on the picture: the design's demo card shows $0.00 while its Edit window shows $5,000.00 (register CT-D09).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R8: “The customer card's "Credit term" shows "{name} (Inactive)" for a deactivated term. Invoices and printed documents show the plain name.”
  • S5-R14: “Term names are never cut off in the Credit Terms dropdown or on the customer card, including with "(Inactive)" or the "Default" tag; long names wrap.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
